diagnosticSteps: 1. DO NOT probe airbag squib directly with DMM! Disconnect battery 10 min. 2. Use 2.2-ohm SRS simulator resistor at column side of clock spring to verify harness/ECU. 3. Replace clock spring.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Driver Airbag Squib Short to Ground — Pinched Column Wire
phContext: Vehicles after aftermarket steering wheel or alarm installation
symptoms: SRS light on immediately after column trim work
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect battery 10 min and inspect yellow SRS wiring along steering column. 2. Check clock spring connector lock tab (built-in shorting bar opens if not fully seated!). 3. Reseat yellow plug.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Side Airbag / Seatbelt Pretensioner Open — Under-Seat Plug
phContext: Sedans/MPVs; water bottle or umbrella sliding under front seat
symptoms: SRS light turns on when sliding seat forward/backward
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect yellow SRS connector under driver/passenger seat for loose/pulled wires. 2. Disconnect battery 10 min, clean pins, and secure harness with zip-tie. 3. Clear SRS code.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Passenger Frontal Airbag Loop Resistance High
phContext: Vehicles after glovebox/cabin filter or A/C evaporator service
symptoms: SRS light on after recent aircon cleaning
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check behind glovebox for unplugged/partially seated yellow passenger airbag connector. 2. Verify shorting-bar clip snaps fully. 3. Clear DTC.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: SRS Control Unit Internal Fault / Crash Data Stored
phContext: Used/repaired PH vehicles involved in minor fender-bender
symptoms: SRS light stays on solid, 'Crash Event Stored' DTC cannot be cleared
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read SRS DTCs (crash data locks most OEM SRS ECUs). 2. Inspect replaced airbags, pretensioners, and front impact sensors. 3. Replace SRS ECU or reset crash EEPROM professionally.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Left Front Impact Sensor Circuit — Bumper Vibration/Corrosion
phContext: Pickups/cars after front bumper bump or flood splash
symptoms: SRS light on, front crash sensor comm/open error
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect battery 10 min. 2. Inspect yellow-loomed impact sensor behind front bumper/rad support. 3. Swap L/R sensors (if identical) or test harness continuity to SRS ECU.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Driver Seatbelt Buckle Switch Fault — Spilled Drink / Lint
phContext: Daily commuters; coins/crumbs/soda jammed in seatbelt buckle
symptoms: Seatbelt chime beeps nonstop even when buckled, SRS light on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Monitor Driver Buckle Switch PID while latching/unlatching belt. 2. Clean debris from buckle slot and check 2-pin wire under seat. 3. Replace buckle assembly.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Occupant Classification / Passenger Seat Weight Sensor Fault
phContext: Modern sedans/SUVs; heavy cargo or wet seat cushion
symptoms: Passenger Airbag OFF light stays on or SRS light illuminates
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove heavy items/laptops from front passenger seat. 2. Check under-seat weight sensor connectors. 3. Run Occupant Classification Zero-Point Calibration with seat empty.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Steering Wheel Off-Center After Pothole — Bent Tie Rod
phContext: Metro Manila/provincial lubak impact; EPS pulls or SAS faults follow
symptoms: Car pulls left/right, steering crooked, ESC/EPS light may trigger
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect tie rod ends, ball joints, and lower control arm bushings for bend/play. 2. Perform 4-wheel alignment. 3. Reset SAS and EPS zero-point calibration.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: EPS Motor Circuit Open/Short — Worn Motor Brushes / Plug
phContext: Column/rack EPS with 120,000+ km; burnt 2-pin heavy motor plug
symptoms: Sudden loss of power assist over bumps, burning smell
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect heavy 2-pin motor connector on steering column/rack for melted plastic. 2. Measure motor winding resistance (0.1–0.5 ohms, no short to case). 3. Repair plug or replace motor.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Hydraulic Power Steering Whine & Foam — Air Suction O-Ring
phContext: Older Honda/Toyota/Mitsubishi hydraulic PS; hardened pump suction O-ring
symptoms: Loud whine when cold, foamy/bubbly fluid in reservoir, heavy steering
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect reservoir for frothy bubbles. 2. Replace cheap hardened rubber O-ring on plastic suction elbow at top of PS pump. 3. Bleed air by turning lock-to-lock.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Hydraulic PS Rack Leak — Torn Rack Boots & Pitted Shaft
phContext: Older Innova, Hilux, Vios Gen 1/2; water entering torn rack bellows
symptoms: Red ATF dripping from steering rack boots, groaning pump
diagnosticSteps: 1. Squeeze rubber rack boots (if full of fluid, internal rack seals are blown). 2. Check steering shaft for rust pitting from floodwater. 3. Rebuild/replace rack & boots.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: EPS Vehicle Speed Signal Fault — Missing ABS/VSS Input
phContext: EPS cars where assist varies with speed (stiffens at highway speed)
symptoms: Steering feels overly light/twitchy at 100 km/h, EPS light on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check Vehicle Speed PID inside EPS module while driving. 2. Scan ABS/ECM for wheel speed sensor faults. 3. Restore CAN speed signal.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: EPS ECU Internal Malfunction — Water / Overvoltage
phContext: Jump-started or flooded EPS vehicles
symptoms: EPS light on permanently, zero assist
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check EPS B+ and IG1 power and ground pins under load. 2. Inspect EPS ECU housing for water stains or burnt MOSFETs. 3. Replace EPS ECU and code/calibrate.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Occupant Classification ECU Malfunction (Toyota)
phContext: Toyota Fortuner/Camry/Altis; wet passenger seat from rain/spill
symptoms: SRS light on, seatbelt reminder erratic
diagnosticSteps: 1. Dry passenger seat cushion completely. 2. Check under-seat Occupant ECU connector for corrosion. 3. Perform Zero-Point & Sensitivity Calibration via scan tool.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Clock Spring Clicking / Scraping Sound When Turning
phContext: Cars where steering rack was disconnected and wheel spun 360°
symptoms: Plastic crunching noise behind steering wheel, followed by SRS/horn failure
diagnosticSteps: 1. Immediately stop turning wheel full lock to prevent ribbon snap. 2. Remove airbag (battery off 10 min!) and wheel; re-center clock spring (typically 2.5–3 turns from stop). 3. Replace if torn.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Steering Angle Sensor Internal Error — Uncentered Install
phContext: Aftermarket/used clock spring installed off by 1 full turn (360°)
symptoms: VSC/ESC light comes on after driving 100 meters
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check SAS PID straight ahead (reads +360° or -360° instead of 0°!). 2. Remove steering wheel and rotate SAS module 1 full turn back to 0°. 3. Run SAS calibration.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Steering Rack Knock / Play on Rough Roads — Rack End / Bushing
phContext: Vios, Mirage, Xpander, City; worn inner tie rod or rack guide bushing
symptoms: Rattle felt in steering wheel over cobblestones/speed bumps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Raise front wheels and rock tire at 9-and-3 o'clock while feeling inner tie rod boot. 2. Check steering intermediate shaft U-joint for play. 3. Replace rack ends / adjust rack guide.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Driver Frontal Stage 1 Deployment Control — Short to Power
phContext: Damaged clock spring or aftermarket cruise/audio tap into SRS harness
symptoms: SRS light on, B0001 active
diagnosticSteps: 1. Never probe live SRS wires. Disconnect battery 10 min and unplug airbag & SRS ECU. 2. Check clock spring pin isolation. 3. Replace clock spring.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Passenger Frontal Stage 1 Control — Loose Dash Harness
phContext: Vehicles after dashboard/evaporator pull-down for A/C repair
symptoms: SRS light on after leaving aircon shop
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect yellow passenger airbag connector behind glovebox for bent pin or unseated lock. 2. Verify with 2.2-ohm test resistor at harness side. 3. Clear SRS code.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Driver Seatbelt Pretensioner Deployment Control — B-Pillar Plug
phContext: Pickups/sedans after side tinting/pillar trim removal
symptoms: SRS light on, pretensioner resistance >4 ohms
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect battery 10 min, remove lower B-pillar trim. 2. Reseat yellow pretensioner plug at seatbelt retractor base. 3. Clear DTC.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: EPS Assist Map Not Written — Blank Replacement ECU
phContext: Toyota/Suzuki after installing brand-new or used EPS ECU
symptoms: EPS light blinking, steering assist weak or absent
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify part number compatibility. 2. Perform Assist Map Writing / Vehicle Spec Coding and Torque Sensor Zero-Point Calibration via scan tool. 3. Test drive.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: EPS Steering Pulls Left/Right Automatically — Misaligned Zero
phContext: After front-end suspension repair without resetting EPS torque sensor
symptoms: Wheel tries to turn itself when released on flat road
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify tire pressures and wheel alignment first. 2. Read EPS Torque Sensor PID hands-off (must be 0.0 N·m). 3. Perform Torque Sensor Zero-Point Calibration.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Driving Side Squib Circuit Open (Toyota) — Classic Spiral Cable
phContext: Toyota Vios/Innova/Fortuner/Hilux (most common Toyota SRS code)
symptoms: Airbag light solid, often intermittent when turning wheel
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read squib resistance PID in SRS live data (normal 1.8–2.8 ohms; >4 ohms = open). 2. Turn steering wheel while watching PID (if it jumps, clock spring ribbon is cracked). 3. Replace spiral cable.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Passenger Side Squib Open (Toyota) — Glovebox Connector
phContext: Toyota Innova/Fortuner/Vios; jarred connector on rough roads
symptoms: SRS light on, passenger squib resistance >4 ohms
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check live squib resistance PID for P-Squib. 2. Disconnect battery 10 min and reseat yellow plug behind glovebox. 3. Check wiring to SRS ECU.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Driver Squib Stage 2 Open (Toyota Dual-Stage Airbag)
phContext: Higher-trim Fortuner/Camry/Altis; 2nd ribbon trace in clock spring
symptoms: SRS light on while horn and Stage 1 still test okay
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check Stage 2 resistance PID in SRS data. 2. Replace dual-stage spiral cable assembly. 3. Verify both Stage 1 and Stage 2 read ~2.2 ohms.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Intermediate Steering Shaft Binding / Stiff Spot Every 180°
phContext: Pickups/SUVs (Hilux, Ranger, Montero) exposed to mud/water
symptoms: Steering feels tight then loose every half-turn of wheel
diagnosticSteps: 1. Spray penetrating lube on lower steering shaft U-joint near exhaust/rack (if it frees up temporarily, U-joint is seized). 2. Replace lower intermediate steering shaft. 3. Re-center SAS.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: EPS Torque Sensor Voltage Difference Fault
phContext: Suzuki Ertiga/Swift, Toyota; water ingress into rack sensor
symptoms: EPS light on, zero power assist
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check Torque Sensor Main vs. Sub voltage PIDs (sum should equal ~5.0V). 2. Inspect sensor connector for moisture. 3. Replace sensor/column.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: SRS Light Stays On 6 Seconds Then Never Turns Off — Can't Comm
phContext: Vehicles with blown SRS ECU fuse or unplugged module
symptoms: Airbag warning solid, scan tool says 'No Response from SRS'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check AIRBAG / IGN 10A fuse in cabin fuse box. 2. Check 12V and ground at SRS ECU under center console. 3. Inspect CAN lines to SRS module.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Right Front Impact Sensor Circuit — Radiator Support Rust
phContext: Coastal vehicles; rusted mounting bolt grounding sensor poorly
symptoms: SRS light on, right front crash sensor fault
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect battery 10 min. 2. Remove sensor, wire-brush rusted radiator support mounting tab (some sensors ground through bolt). 3. Inspect 2-pin plug.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: EPS Motor Relay Stuck ON/OFF — High Current Weld
phContext: High-mileage EPS columns; internal relay contact welding
symptoms: EPS light on, assist cuts out intermittently
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clear DTC and cycle ignition; if C1555 returns immediately at KOEO, internal EPS ECU relay is welded. 2. Replace EPS ECU. 3. Check motor amperage draw.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Steering Wheel Shakes at 80–100 km/h — Unbalanced / Bent Rim
phContext: Cars hitting deep Metro Manila/provincial potholes
symptoms: Vibration in steering wheel only between 80–100 km/h
diagnosticSteps: 1. Spin front wheels on balancer to check for bent inner rim lip or tire bulge (bukol). 2. Road-force balance wheels. 3. Check lower ball joints and tie rods.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Front Impact Sensor Comm Error (Mitsubishi)
phContext: Mitsubishi Montero/Xpander/Mirage; corroded front sensor
symptoms: SRS Service Required on dash
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect battery 10 min. 2. Inspect front impact sensors behind grille/headlights. 3. Replace faulty sensor and clear SRS memory.

domainName: Electric Power Steering (EPS), SRS Airbag & Restraints
title: Aftermarket Boss Kit / Racing Wheel Causing SRS Light
phContext: Modified hatchbacks/pickups; airbag removed without resistor
symptoms: Airbag light solid, passenger airbags may be disabled by SRS logic!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Educate owner that removing driver airbag disables safety system. 2. If restoring OEM wheel, inspect clock spring and reconnect airbag properly. 3. Clear SRS DTCs.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Control Module Comm Bus A Off — Shorted CAN-H to CAN-L
phContext: Any CAN vehicle; crushed harness or water-soaked junction block
symptoms: Christmas-tree dash, tach/temp gauges dead, no crank
diagnosticSteps: 1. Battery OFF: measure OBD-II Pin 6 (CAN-H) to Pin 14 (CAN-L) — normal is 60 ohms; ~0–5 ohms = dead short! 2. Unplug modules one by one (ABS, TCM, EPS, BCM) until 60/120 ohms returns. 3. Repair shorted wire/module.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with ECM/PCM — Missing Power/Ground or Open CAN
phContext: All OBD-II vehicles; blown EFI/ECM fuse or chewed CAN pair
symptoms: Cranks no start (or no crank), scan tool cannot talk to Engine ECM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if MIL lights up at KOEO (no MIL = ECM unpowered!). 2. Check ECM B+, IG1, and ground pins with test light. 3. Measure CAN-H (2.6–3.5V) and CAN-L (1.5–2.4V) at ECM plug.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: OBD-II DLC Pin 16 Dead — Blown OBD / CIG Fuse
phContext: Vehicles where technician's scan tool won't power on when plugged in
symptoms: Scan tool screen stays blank at DLC port
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure Pin 16 (Battery +) to Pin 4 (Chassis GND) and Pin 5 (Signal GND) — must be 12V. 2. Check 7.5A/10A OBD/DOME/CIG fuse (often blown by cheap ELM327 dongles or dashcam adapters). 3. Repair Pin 4/5 ground.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with ABS/VSC Module — Unplugged or Blown Fuse
phContext: Vehicles after front collision repair or engine bay wash
symptoms: ABS + Brake + ESC lights on, speedometer dead, no comm with ABS
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check ABS main fuses and IG1 ignition feed to ABS connector. 2. Measure CAN-H/L resistance at ABS plug (if 120 ohms, one terminating resistor or branch is open). 3. Check ABS grounds.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with Instrument Cluster (IPC) — CAN Gateway Fault
phContext: Ford Ranger/EcoSport, Mazda, Nissan; cluster solder cracks or flood
symptoms: Gauges freeze, engine won't crank (immobilizer lives in cluster on Ford/Mazda!)
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check IPC constant 12V and IG1 power/ground. 2. Scope CAN-H/L at cluster rear connector. 3. Inspect Ford/Mazda cluster PCB for cracked main connector solder joints.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with Body Control Module (BCM) — Flood / Alarm Tap
phContext: Mitsubishi Xpander/Montero, Ford, Hyundai; botched aftermarket alarm
symptoms: No interior lights, wipers/locks dead, push-start dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect BCM connectors at driver kick-panel for aftermarket T-tap splices or water. 2. Check BCM B+ fuses and ground. 3. Unplug aftermarket GPS/alarm immobilizer box to test.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with TCM — Corroded Underbody CAN Branch
phContext: AT/CVT vehicles; rodent/splash damage on gearbox CAN wires
symptoms: Gear indicator dashes, engine in limp mode, no TCM comms
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure 60 ohms across CAN pins at TCM connector (key off). 2. Verify TCM 12V IG1 and ground under load. 3. Trace twisted green/white or blue/white CAN pair back to splice.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with SRS Airbag Module — Unplugged Under Console
phContext: Used cars where seller/detailer unplugged SRS to hide crash light
symptoms: SRS light on solid (or taped over!), no comm with SRS ECU
diagnosticSteps: 1. Lift center console trim and verify SRS ECU is actually plugged in! 2. Check AIRBAG IG1 fuse and ground. 3. Scope CAN lines at SRS connector.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with HVAC Control Module — Loose Dash Plug
phContext: Cars after aftermarket Android head-unit installation
symptoms: A/C controls dead or flashing, blower stuck
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove Android head unit trim and check if HVAC CAN connector was left loose/pinched. 2. Check HVAC 10A IG fuse. 3. Verify CAN-H/L continuity.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with EPS Control Module — Blown EPS IG Fuse
phContext: Toyota, Honda, Hyundai, Suzuki; heavy steering + U0131 in ECM/ABS
symptoms: EPS light on, heavy steering, no EPS comm
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check small 7.5A/10A EPS-IG fuse (separate from 50A motor fuse!). 2. Verify CAN-H/L at EPS ECU. 3. Check EPS ground.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Aftermarket GPS Tracker / Fleet Telematics Jamming CAN Bus
phContext: TNVS/Grab, delivery vans, financing-tracked cars; cheap OBD splitter
symptoms: Random limp mode, gauges drop out, scan tool fails mid-scan
diagnosticSteps: 1. Look under steering column for hidden Y-splitter harness connected to OBD-II port! 2. Unplug fleet GPS/telematics module completely and re-test vehicle. 3. Check if CAN bus recovers.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: High Speed CAN Comm Bus — 120 Ohms (Open Terminating Resistor)
phContext: Vehicles with broken CAN trunk wire or unplugged end-node
symptoms: Intermittent module drop-offs, erratic warning lights
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure Pin 6 to Pin 14 resistance key-off: 120 ohms means ONE 120-ohm terminating resistor (usually ECM or IPC) is disconnected from the bus! 2. Locate open branch via voltage/resistance splits. 3. Repair.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: High Speed CAN Bus Performance — Short to 12V or Ground
phContext: Chafed harness near alternator/starter or firewall grommet
symptoms: Total bus collapse, CAN-H stuck at 12V or 0V
diagnosticSteps: 1. Key ON: measure Pin 6 (CAN-H) to Pin 4 (GND) and Pin 14 (CAN-L) to Pin 4. Normal is ~2.6V and ~2.4V. 2. If either is 0V or 12V, trace short to ground/power by unplugging branches.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: K-Line (ISO 9141 / KWP2000) No Comm — Aftermarket Radio Short
phContext: Older 2000–2010 Toyota/Mitsubishi/Honda/ Nissan; Pin 7 K-Line
symptoms: Scan tool fails to connect to engine/ABS on older PH cars
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure Pin 7 (K-Line) voltage at KOEO (normal 9–12V pull-up; 0V = shorted to ground!). 2. Unplug aftermarket Android/2-DIN radio (sometimes K-Line pin is wired to radio harness ground!). 3. Isolate Pin 7.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Nissan CAN Comm Circuit — Classic Ground / IPDM Fault
phContext: Nissan Navara/Almera/Urvan/X-Trail; corroded IPDM/ECM ground
symptoms: Multiple modules store U1000, intermittent no-start
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean ECM and IPDM (engine bay fuse box) chassis ground bolts on inner fender. 2. Measure CAN resistance (60 ohms) and inspect IPDM connectors for water. 3. Clear U1000 across all modules.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with Throttle Actuator Module — Open CAN/Power
phContext: Vehicles with external ETC module or Ford/GM electronic throttle
symptoms: Limp mode, no pedal response
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check ETC fuse and relay. 2. Inspect throttle body 6-pin connector and harness. 3. Verify ECM power/grounds.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with Steering Angle Sensor — Unplugged Clock Spring
phContext: Cars after steering wheel/column repair
symptoms: ESC/VSC light on, no SAS PID response
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect 4/5-pin SAS connector behind steering wheel. 2. Check IG1 12V, GND, and CAN-H/L at SAS plug. 3. Replace SAS if internal transceiver is dead.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Invalid Data Received from ECM/PCM — Secondary Flag in ABS/TCM
phContext: All modern CAN cars; ECM has an active sensor/misfire fault
symptoms: ABS/TCM stores U0401 whenever Engine MIL turns on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Do NOT replace ABS or TCM! U0401 means ECM is broadcasting 'faulted torque/load data'. 2. Fix primary Engine ECM DTC first. 3. Clear U0401.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Invalid Data Received from TCM — Secondary Flag in ECM/ABS
phContext: AT/CVT vehicles; TCM has an active range/speed sensor fault
symptoms: ECM/ABS stores U0402
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan TCM for primary P-codes (e.g., P0705, P0715). 2. Repair TCM fault. 3. Clear U0402.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Invalid Data Received from ABS — Wheel Speed Implausible
phContext: ECM/TCM/EPS storing U0415 due to bad wheel speed sensor
symptoms: Speedo/shift erratic, VSC light on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan ABS module for C-codes (wheel speed sensor, brake switch, G-sensor). 2. Fix ABS sensor fault. 3. Clear U0415.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with ECM B / Hybrid / Secondary Controller
phContext: Hybrid or dual-ECU diesel vehicles (EDU/VNT driver)
symptoms: No start or severe limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check secondary controller fuse and relay. 2. Verify CAN/LIN link between primary ECM and sub-controller. 3. Inspect water exposure.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: LIN Bus Communication Error — Smart Alternator / Wiper / IBS
phContext: Ford, Hyundai, Honda, BYD; broken single-wire LIN bus
symptoms: Battery light on, auto-wipers dead, or power window one-touch dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope single-wire LIN bus (should show 0–12V square-wave packets at ~9–11V idle). 2. Unplug LIN slaves (alternator, BMS, rain sensor) one by one to find which pulls LIN to 0V/12V. 3. Repair wire.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Mitsubishi/Chrysler Engine/TCM CAN Timeout
phContext: Mitsubishi Montero/Strada/Xpander/ Mirage; loose ETACS/CAN plug
symptoms: Multiple warning chimes, erratic wiper/lights
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect ETACS (BCM) connectors at driver fuse box for loose seating or moisture. 2. Check CAN resistance (60 ohms). 3. Clear codes after reseating.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with Hybrid/EV Control Module
phContext: Toyota Corolla Cross/Yaris Cross HEV, BYD, Nissan Kicks e-POWER
symptoms: Hybrid System Malfunction, Ready light won't come on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 12V auxiliary battery first (low 12V prevents HV ECU boot!). 2. Check IGCT/HEV fuses in engine bay. 3. Scope CAN lines to HV ECU.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with Immobilizer Module — Key/Ring Fault
phContext: Ford, Hyundai, Mitsubishi, Honda; blown IMMO fuse or bad coil
symptoms: Security light flashes rapidly, cranks no start or no crank
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check IMMO/SMARTRA 10A fuse. 2. Check 12V, GND, and LIN/CAN data at ignition barrel antenna/module. 3. Re-sync immobilizer if replaced.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with Door Control Module (Driver/Passenger)
phContext: Modern SUVs/sedans with CAN-controlled door modules
symptoms: Driver window/mirror/centra l lock dead, passenger side works
diagnosticSteps: 1. Flex rubber boot in driver door jamb while testing continuity (broken 12V/GND/CAN wire at hinge!). 2. Check Door 20A/30A fuse. 3. Solder flexible silicone wire across hinge.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with Steering Column Control Module (SCCM)
phContext: Ford Ranger/Everest/Focus; clock spring / stalk module
symptoms: Wipers, turn signals, horn, and cruise buttons dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check SCCM fuse in cabin BCM. 2. Scope MS-CAN/HS-CAN at steering column module. 3. Replace SCCM if powered and grounded properly.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with Fuel Pump Control Module (FPCM)
phContext: Ford, Hyundai/Kia GDI, modern crossovers; rear underbody module
symptoms: Cranks no start, no fuel pressure
diagnosticSteps: 1. Locate FPCM near rear seat/fuel tank and check 20A fuel pump fuse. 2. Inspect connector for floodwater corrosion. 3. Check PWM/CAN command from ECM.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Scan Tool Connects to ECM Only, Fails on ABS/SRS/BCM
phContext: Older PH vehicles (2005– 2013) with split K-Line / CAN pins on DLC
symptoms: Engine reads fine, other modules show 'Link Error'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if vehicle uses Pin 7 (ECM), Pin 12/13 (ABS/SRS), or MS-CAN Pins 3/11 (Ford)! 2. Verify DLC pin tension (spread female pins from cheap dongles). 3. Use OEM-pinout multiplexer VCI.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with Park Brake Control Module (EPB)
phContext: Vehicles with electronic parking brake; blown rear EPB fuse
symptoms: EPB warning light, brake stuck or won't apply
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check dual 25A/30A EPB fuses. 2. Inspect EPB ECU connector (often under rear console or trunk) for moisture. 3. Check CAN bus resistance.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Invalid Data Received from BCM — Wrong Tire/Configuration
phContext: Ford Ranger/Everest after FORScan/tire size change without PCM relearn
symptoms: Wrench light on, P160A/U0422 stored
diagnosticSteps: 1. Run PCM/TCM Module Initialization / Relearn after changing tire size or axle ratio in BCM. 2. Verify VIN matches across BCM and PCM. 3. Clear DTCs.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with Audio/Head Unit — Aftermarket Android Upgrade
phContext: Modern cars (Xpander, City, Ranger, Geely) with stock radio removed
symptoms: Hidden U0184 stored in BCM/Gateway (usually harmless unless A/C linked)
diagnosticSteps: 1. If A/C or steering buttons died with Android unit, check CAN-bus decoder box (Raise/SimpleSoft) wiring. 2. Verify stock CAN wires weren't grounded. 3. Ignore harmless U0184 if all functions work.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Ford CAN Comm Bus Fault — Intermittent Cluster Solder
phContext: Ford Everest/Ranger/Focus (2007–2015); classic IPC cold solder joints
symptoms: PatS security light flashes, gauges drop to 0, stalls/no-start
diagnosticSteps: 1. Tap top of instrument cluster while running (if gauges jump/drop, confirmed IPC solder fault). 2. Remove cluster and reflow all main connector pins + CAN transceiver. 3. Clear U1900.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: CAN Bus Asleep / Won't Wake Up for Diagnostics
phContext: Modern push-start cars with dead smart key or faulty ignition relay
symptoms: Scan tool says 'Turn Ignition ON' even when button pressed
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if dash cluster actually wakes up (IG1 relay active). 2. Turn on hazard lights (wakes Body CAN on many cars) and try scanning BCM. 3. Check Start-Stop button fuse.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with Transfer Case Control Module (4WD)
phContext: 4x4 Pickups/SUVs (Hilux, Ranger, Montero, Navara); under-seat/floor ECU
symptoms: 4WD light flashing/off, stuck in 2H or 4H
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 4WD 20A/30A fuse. 2. Inspect 4WD ECU under center console/kick-panel for floodwater. 3. Verify CAN-H/L and actuator limit switch signals.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with Vehicle Dynamics Control (VDC/ESP)
phContext: Nissan, Subaru, Hyundai; same root checks as U0121
symptoms: VDC/Slip light solid
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify ABS/VDC 12V power and ground under load. 2. Measure CAN-H/L at VDC plug. 3. Inspect engine bay splice.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Internal Control Module Software Incompatibility
phContext: Vehicles after swapping used ECM/TCM/BCM with wrong part suffix
symptoms: Starts then stalls, or limp mode with U0300
diagnosticSteps: 1. Compare hardware/software calibration IDs of all modules. 2. Flash matching OEM firmware or install exact matching part number. 3. Perform module initialization.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: 60-Ohm Resistance Looks Good, Still No Comm — Single Wire Open
phContext: One CAN-H or CAN-L wire broken between DLC and splice
symptoms: 60 ohms measured if break is past DLC, or 120 ohms; module silent
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always check BOTH resistance (60 Ω) AND oscilloscope voltage symmetry (CAN-H 2.5->3.5V, CAN-L 2.5->1.5V mirror image). 2. Trace broken wire to affected module. 3. Repair twisted pair.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with BCM A / Front Junction Box (TIPM/ETACS)
phContext: Mitsubishi, Chrysler/Dodge, Hyundai; corroded engine bay junction box
symptoms: Headlights/wipers stuck on, no crank
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect engine bay junction box connectors for water/heat melt. 2. Check main 12V feed and ground. 3. Test internal PCB relays.

domainName: CAN Bus, LIN, K-Line & ECU Network Communication
title: Lost Comm with Cruise/Radar Distance Sensor — Bumper Hit
phContext: Modern ADAS cars (Fortuner, Montero, City Sensing, BYD)
symptoms: ACC/AEB warning on dash after minor front bumper tap or grille wash
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect front radar bracket behind emblem/lower grille for bent angle or unplugged wire. 2. Check radar 12V/CAN supply. 3. Perform static/dynamic ADAS radar calibration.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Engine Immobilizer System Malfunction (Toyota) — Key/Sync
phContext: Toyota Vios/Innova/Fortuner/Hilux; after dead battery or ECU swap
symptoms: Cranks normally, fires for 1 sec and stalls (or cranks no-spark), Security light blinks
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if Security LED turns OFF when key inserted (if keeps blinking, key transponder not read). 2. Try spare key. 3. If ECU/Immo replaced, jump DLC Pins 4 & 13 for 35 min (KOEO) to re-sync ID.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Smart Key Not Detected — Weak CR2032 Fob Battery / Interference
phContext: Push-start cars (Xpander, Vios G, City, Montero); phone/RF interference
symptoms: Door request button unresponsive, 'Key Not Detected' on cluster
diagnosticSteps: 1. Touch key fob emblem directly against Start-Stop button to start via passive NFC backup. 2. Replace fob CR2032/CR2025 battery (must read >3.0V!). 3. Keep fob away from phone/dashcam RF noise.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: PATS Received Incorrect Key Code (Ford) — Unprogrammed Key
phContext: Ford Ranger/Everest/EcoSport/ Fiesta; non-transponder duplicate key
symptoms: Rapidly flashing red padlock light, starter disabled completely
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if metal duplicate key lacks transponder chip inside head. 2. Check PATS transceiver ring around ignition lock. 3. Program minimum 2 transponder keys via scan tool.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Central Locking Buzzes/Clicks Without Locking — Weak Actuator
phContext: Toyota Vios/Innova, Honda City, Mitsubishi; worn plastic worm gear/motor
symptoms: One door fails to lock/unlock with remote, faint buzz inside door
diagnosticSteps: 1. Manually flip lock tab (if stiff, check linkage). 2. Measure 12V pulse (polarity-reversing) at door actuator 2-pin plug during lock/unlock. 3. Replace weak Mabuchi DC motor inside latch.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Alarm Goes Off Randomly at Night — Corroded Hood/Door Switch
phContext: Factory & aftermarket alarms (Montero, Fortuner, Vios); wet hood pin
symptoms: Horn/siren blasts at 2 AM with nobody near car
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan BCM 'Last Alarm Trigger History' PID (identifies exact door/hood/trunk!). 2. Unplug engine bay hood ajar switch to test (rust/water often shorts it to ground). 3. Replace corroded pin switch.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Aftermarket LED Headlights Flickering / Hyper-Flashing Signals
phContext: Halogen-to-LED bulb upgrades without load resistors or CANbus decoders
symptoms: Turn signals blink 2x faster, or DRL/low beam flickers
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect LED driver polarity and wattage (low draw mimics burnt bulb to BCM). 2. Install proper 6-ohm/50W load resistors for turn signals or enable LED mode in BCM. 3. Check ground.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Turn Signals Stay Solid (Don't Blink) — Stuck Flasher Relay
phContext: Older cars with mechanical/thermal 3-pin flasher relay
symptoms: Signal indicator stays lit solid left and right
diagnosticSteps: 1. Locate flasher relay under driver dash; tap it lightly. 2. Check all 4 corner bulbs (one burnt bulb or wrong wattage stops thermal flasher). 3. Replace flasher relay.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Power Window Auto-Up Reverses Halfway — Pinch Sensor / Dirty Track
phContext: Cars with one-touch auto-up driver window; dusty PH roads
symptoms: Window goes up 80% then drops back down automatically
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean rubber window run channel and apply dry silicone lube (friction triggers anti-pinch!). 2. Reset window limit: hold switch DOWN 5 sec, then UP 5 sec after closing. 3. Inspect regulator.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Power Mirrors Won't Fold — Stripped Plastic Folding Gear
phContext: Pickups/SUVs (Montero, Fortuner, Ranger, City) brushed by motorcycles in traffic
symptoms: Mirror motor whirs nonstop without moving mirror housing
diagnosticSteps: 1. Listen for motor running inside mirror (confirms power & switch are good). 2. Disassemble mirror pivot and replace stripped plastic/nylon worm gear with brass gear kit. 3. Test fold.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: BCM Output Shorted to Ground — Melted Tail/License Plate Socket
phContext: Cars with water-filled license plate lights or trailer wiring
symptoms: Left/right park lights dead, BCM locks out circuit until code cleared
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug rear license plate and tail light bulbs; inspect for melted sockets. 2. Measure circuit resistance to ground. 3. Repair short and clear BCM FET lockout DTC (cycle ignition).

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Dome / Map Light Won't Turn Off — Broken Door Ajar Switch
phContext: Older sedans/MPVs; worn rubber-booted jamb switch or latch switch
symptoms: Door Ajar warning stays on dash, battery drains overnight
diagnosticSteps: 1. Press each door jamb pin switch manually while watching dash icon. 2. Unscrew suspect jamb switch (often rusted mounting screw = bad ground, or stuck plunger). 3. Clean or replace switch.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Windshield Wipers Stop Mid-Glass — Worn Park Switch Contacts
phContext: Frequent heavy monsoon wiper use; burnt grease on gear wheel
symptoms: Wipers freeze anywhere on glass when turned off, intermittent mode dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check wiper motor 5-pin plug for 12V ignition feed (powers park return!). 2. Open wiper motor gear cover, clean burnt grease off copper park contacts, and re-grease. 3. Check linkage.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Washer Fluid Won't Spray — Algae-Clogged Pump / Rat-Chewed Hose
phContext: Cars topped up with plain tap water instead of washer fluid
symptoms: Pump hums with no spray, or silent completely
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect hose at hood T-fitting to test if pump pushes water. 2. Inspect washer hose under hood liner for rat bites! 3. Pull pump from bottle and clean algae off rubber grommet filter.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Steering Column Lock (ESL/ELV) Won't Unlock — Jammed Motor
phContext: Push-start cars (Nissan, Mercedes, Hyundai, Mitsubishi); worn ESL motor
symptoms: Dash stays black when pressing Start button, wheel locked
diagnosticSteps: 1. Turn steering wheel gently left-right while pressing Start (relieves pin bind on column). 2. Tap ESL housing under column lightly while pressing Start. 3. Replace ESL motor or install emulator.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Brake Lights & Horn Dead — Shared 15A STOP/HORN Fuse
phContext: Toyota, Honda, Mitsubishi sharing STOP and HORN circuit
symptoms: Shifter stuck in Park, no brake lights, no horn
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 10A/15A HORN/STOP fuse in engine bay box. 2. Unplug aftermarket horn or third brake light if fuse blows instantly. 3. Replace fuse.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Steering Lock / Key Cylinder Illumination Fault
phContext: Mitsubishi/Nissan; broken key-in-ignition microswitch
symptoms: Car beeps as if key is still in ignition when door opens
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect 2-pin key-reminder switch on ignition cylinder housing. 2. Clean sticky lock cylinder with dry graphite/PTFE (never heavy oil). 3. Replace switch.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Rear Defogger / Heated Mirror Dead — Broken Glass Tab
phContext: Hatchbacks/SUVs after rear windshield tint scraping
symptoms: Rear glass stays foggy in rain, defogger button lights up but no heat
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure 12V across left and right copper busbar tabs on rear glass. 2. Inspect vertical grid lines for razor-blade tint cuts. 3. Repair with conductive silver epoxy.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Android Head Unit Draining Battery — ACC/B+ Wires Swapped
phContext: Aftermarket 9-inch/10-inch Android stereos installed by DIYers
symptoms: Radio forgets clock/stations OR stays in sleep mode draining battery
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure yellow (Constant 12V B+) and red (Switched 12V ACC) at radio harness with key OFF and ACC. 2. Swap if reversed, or verify CANbus box cuts ACC cleanly. 3. Measure parasitic draw.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Reverse Camera Shows 'No Signal' — Blown Reverse Light Tap
phContext: Aftermarket reverse cameras powered off reverse bulb wire
symptoms: Black screen with guidelines when shifting to Reverse
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if reverse lights actually turn on (if not, check Reverse switch/fuse). 2. Measure 12V at camera power tap near trunk lid (flexed wires break at trunk hinge!). 3. Resolder power/RCA.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Key Fob Unlocks Car From 1 Meter Only — Dirty Rubber Pad
phContext: Aged 3-button flip/smart keys; worn carbon pads or weak battery
symptoms: Must stand right next to driver door and press hard
diagnosticSteps: 1. Open fob, clean PCB gold contacts with isopropyl alcohol, and test CR2032 voltage (>3.0V). 2. Check RF receiver module in rear C-pillar. 3. Note: heavy metallic window tint weakens RF range!

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Keyless Entry Receiver Comm Error — Metallic Tint / Wet C-Pillar
phContext: Sedans/SUVs with rear-glass antenna & dark metallic tint
symptoms: Both key fobs suddenly lose range or stop working remotely
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test both fobs with fresh batteries at 30 cm from rear glass. 2. Inspect RF tuner module behind rear pillar trim for condensation. 3. Check 5V/LIN data from BCM.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Taillights Out, Brake Lights Work — Blown TAIL 10A Fuse
phContext: Cars with aftermarket plate-frame LEDs or wet trailer socket
symptoms: No rear running lights, no dash illumination at night
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 10A TAIL fuse in cabin fuse box. 2. Unplug aftermarket LEDs/fog lights tapped into park light wire. 3. Test park light relay.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Sunroof Stuck Open or Leaks Onto Headliner — Clogged Drains
phContext: SUVs/crossovers (Territory, Everest, Forester, CR-V); tree debris
symptoms: Water dripping from A-pillar grab handle or dome light during rain
diagnosticSteps: 1. Open sunroof and locate 4 corner drain holes. 2. Feed flexible weed-trimmer line down front/rear drains and flush gently with water. 3. Reset sunroof anti-pinch limit.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Driver Window Switch Dead for Passenger Windows — Lockout Button
phContext: Most common 'false fault' in PH workshops!
symptoms: Driver can control all windows, passengers cannot (or vice versa)
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check Window Lock button on driver master switch first! 2. Test master switch vs. individual door switch contacts for burnt carbon. 3. Check A-pillar door jamb harness.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Ford/Mazda BCM Exterior Light Overload — Wrong Bulb Wattage
phContext: Ford Ranger/Everest; 21W/5W bulb replaced with wrong dual/single filament
symptoms: One brake/turn light stays off, BCM logs short/overload
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify exact bulb base (e.g., 7443 vs. 7440; 1157 vs. 1156) — single-contact bulb in dual socket shorts park & brake! 2. Install correct bulb. 3. Clear BCM DTC.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Automatic Headlights Stay On Daytime — Covered Dash Sensor
phContext: Cars with Auto-Headlight dash sensor covered by dash mat / toll RFID
symptoms: Headlights stay on at noon, dash screen dims to night mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check top of dashboard near windshield for dash mats, tissues, or RFID stickers covering the dome light sensor! 2. Read Light Sensor PID in BCM. 3. Unplug/test sensor if clear.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Speed-Sensing Auto Door Lock Stopped Working — VSS / Aftermarket
phContext: Vios, Xpander, City; aftermarket OBD auto-lock dongle unplugged
symptoms: Doors no longer auto-lock at 20 km/h
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if car uses factory BCM setting or an aftermarket OBD plug-in auto-locker. 2. Verify vehicle speed PID in BCM. 3. Re-enable auto-lock in cluster/BCM settings.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Wiper Fluid Leaks Under Bumper — Cracked Reservoir / Pump Seal
phContext: Front-right fender impact or dry-rotted pump grommet
symptoms: Washer tank empties onto garage floor within hours
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove right front wheel liner to expose washer bottle. 2. Fill with water and inspect rubber pump grommet and level sensor seal. 3. Replace hardened rubber grommet.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Tailgate Struts Weak — Hatch Drops on Head
phContext: 5+ year old hatchbacks/SUVs/MPVs (Wigo, Mirage, Fortuner, Xpander)
symptoms: Tailgate feels heavy and falls closed automatically
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect gas strut shafts for oil film/leakage. 2. Replace both left and right gas struts in pairs (check Newton force rating). 3. If power tailgate, check spindle motor & pinch strip.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Power Tailgate Beeps and Reverses — Weak Strut or Latch Sensor
phContext: Fortuner, Montero, Territory, Everest with power liftgate
symptoms: Tailgate opens halfway then beeps and closes (or refuses to latch)
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check battery voltage (run engine to test!). 2. Inspect rear latch cinch motor and side pinch-sensor strips for water. 3. Re-initialize tailgate height memory.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Climate Control / Dash Switch Stuck Button
phContext: Cars with spilled coffee/milk tea on center console buttons
symptoms: A/C or hazard button sticks physically or triggers DTC
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect switch bezel for sticky residue. 2. Clean with electronics contact cleaner. 3. Check switch matrix resistance values.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Immobilizer Key Transponder Lost — Dropped Key Fob
phContext: Toyota/Honda/Mitsubishi flip keys dropped hard on concrete
symptoms: Key unlocks doors remotely, but engine cranks and won't start
diagnosticSteps: 1. Open key shell — check if tiny black carbon/glass transponder chip fell out when battery was changed! 2. Test key in RF transponder reader coil. 3. Program new chip.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Hazard Lights Flash Continuously — Aftermarket Alarm Valet Mode
phContext: Used cars with aftermarket alarm triggered after battery reconnect
symptoms: Hazards blink nonstop for 30 sec whenever battery reconnected or door opened
diagnosticSteps: 1. Locate hidden aftermarket alarm override/valet button under driver dash. 2. Turn key ON and press/hold valet button 5 sec (or press unlock on alarm remote). 3. Inspect alarm box.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: High Beam Indicator Dead / One High Beam Out — Relay/Stalk
phContext: Older cars with direct-switched stalks (no relay); burnt dimmer switch
symptoms: Low beams work, pulling stalk for high beams kills lights
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check HI-BEAM L/R fuses. 2. Probe headlight plug for 12V and ground (many Japanese cars switch GROUND via stalk!). 3. Clean burnt copper contacts in headlight stalk.

domainName: Body Control Module (BCM), Immobilizer, Keyless & Lighting
title: Glovebox / Center Console 12V USB Port Dead — Internal Fuse
phContext: Modern MPVs/SUVs (Xpander, Stargazer, Veloz); overloaded USB port
symptoms: Factory USB data/charging port dead, CarPlay/Android Auto won't connect
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test with known-good short OEM USB cable first! 2. Check USB/Audio fuse in cabin box. 3. Inspect rear of USB socket behind console for unplugged harness.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: High Voltage System Interlock Circuit High — Loose Service Plug
phContext: Toyota HEV, BYD, Nissan e-POWER; orange HV service plug not locked
symptoms: Ready light won't turn on, 'Check Hybrid System' warning
diagnosticSteps: 1. Wear Class 0 (1000V) insulated gloves! 2. Verify orange HV service disconnect plug is pushed in AND slid/latched fully (triggers microswitch). 3. Check inverter cover interlock switch.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Hybrid/EV Battery Voltage System Isolation Fault — Flood/Moisture
phContext: HEV/PHEV/EV driven through floodwater or high-pressure engine wash
symptoms: Ready light inhibited, red HV isolation warning on cluster
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check isolation resistance PID (must be >500 Ω/V; <100 kΩ triggers P0AA6). 2. Inspect underbody orange HV cables, A/C compressor (HV-driven!), and battery pack breather for water. 3. Megger-test isolated circuits safely.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: EV / Hybrid Won't Enter 'READY' Mode — Dead 12V Aux Battery
phContext: BYD, Toyota HEV, Nissan Kicks; 12V battery drained (cannot close HV contactors!)
symptoms: Dash flickers or stays dark, HV battery is 80% full yet car won't move
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure 12V auxiliary battery (if <11.5V, HV main relays cannot pull in!). 2. Jump-start 12V terminals ONLY (never touch orange HV cables!). 3. Check DC-DC converter output (13.8– 14.4V) once READY.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Replace Hybrid Battery Pack — Weak Cell Block Imbalance
phContext: High-mileage Toyota Prius/Corolla Cross/Camry HEV; PH heat aging NiMH/Li-ion
symptoms: HV cooling fan roars loudly, battery bar jumps 20%->80% fast, P0A80
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read all HV Battery Block Voltages (V01–V14+) under load/regen (delta >0.3–0.5V = weak block). 2. Check internal resistance PIDs per block. 3. Clean HV battery cooling fan first; recondition or replace pack.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Inverter Cooling System Performance — Dead Electric Water Pump
phContext: Toyota HEV, BYD, Nissan e-POWER; failed brushless 12V inverter pump
symptoms: Hybrid overheat warning in traffic, inverter derates power
diagnosticSteps: 1. Open inverter coolant reservoir cap at READY/IG-ON and look for turbulent fluid circulation. 2. Check Inverter Water Pump 12V fuse and listen for pump hum. 3. Replace electric pump and bleed carefully.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Hybrid Battery Cooling Fan Clogged with Dust / Pet Hair
phContext: Toyota Corolla Cross/Innova Zenix/Prius; intake grille under rear seat
symptoms: HV battery temp >50°C in PH summer, reduced EV assist
diagnosticSteps: 1. Locate HV battery intake vent under rear seat cushion/side trim. 2. Remove grille and vacuum lint/dust from blower wheel. 3. Read HV Battery Temp 1–3 PIDs (keep <45°C).

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: EV AC Charger Won't Start — Poor PH Condo/Home Grounding
phContext: BYD Atto 3/Dolphin/Sealion 6, MG4, Tesla; ungrounded PH 220V outlet
symptoms: Portable EVSE flashes red 'Ground Fault', refuses to charge
diagnosticSteps: 1. Many older PH houses lack true Earth Ground (PE)! EVSE checks Line-to-Ground voltage. 2. Install proper dedicated 32A breaker + copper ground rod (<5 ohms). 3. Test with grounded Type-2 EVSE.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Charging Gun Stuck Locked in EV Port — Actuator Jam / 12V Low
phContext: BYD, MG, Tesla, Hyundai EVs; Type-2 / CCS2 lock pin jammed
symptoms: Charging stopped, cable won't pull out of car
diagnosticSteps: 1. Press Unlock on key fob twice (releases lock pin for 15–30 sec). 2. Push gun inward gently while pressing unlock to relieve pin friction. 3. Use manual emergency pull-cable inside trunk/frunk.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: DC-DC Converter Performance — Not Charging 12V Aux Battery
phContext: Toyota HEV, BYD, Nissan e-POWER; blown HV DC-DC fuse or inverter fault
symptoms: 12V battery dies while driving, dash warnings cascade
diagnosticSteps: 1. Put car in READY mode and measure 12V battery voltage (must jump to 13.8–14.4V; if 12.2V, DC-DC failed!). 2. Check 12V DC-DC sense wire/fuse. 3. Scan Inverter/HV ECU for DC-DC DTCs.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Hybrid/EV Battery Pack Deterioration — High Temp / Age
phContext: 4–8 year old HEVs in hot urban taxi/fleet use
symptoms: Reduced EV-only range, frequent ICE startup
diagnosticSteps: 1. Log HV battery capacity (Ah / SOH %) and block internal resistance. 2. Inspect HV busbars for copper corrosion (NiMH packs). 3. Replace degraded module/pack.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: HV Battery Control System Malfunction — Sense Wire Corrosion
phContext: Toyota HEV; corroded voltage sense harness inside HV pack
symptoms: HV warning light, P3000 + P0A80
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect voltage sense connector on Battery Smart Unit for green corrosion or broken thin wires. 2. Clean copper busbars and torque nuts to spec. 3. Clear codes.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Motor Electronics Coolant Pump A Control — Air Lock
phContext: PHEV/BEV (BYD DM-i, MG, Hyundai); air pocket after coolant service
symptoms: Power limited warning, thermal derating
diagnosticSteps: 1. Perform scan-tool electric pump bleed routine (do not just pour coolant!). 2. Check PWM control signal to electric pump. 3. Inspect radiator fins.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: HV Electric A/C Compressor Dead — Non-Conductive Oil Error
phContext: HEV/EVs serviced with regular PAG oil instead of POE (ND-11) oil!
symptoms: P0AA6 isolation fault immediately after A/C recharge!
diagnosticSteps: 1. CRITICAL: Regular PAG oil is electrically conductive and shorts 300V+ HV A/C compressor windings! 2. Flush system and use ONLY non-conductive POE (ND-OIL 11) + dedicated R134a/R1234yf hoses. 3. Megger-test compressor.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Engine Failed to Start (Hybrid) — Out of Gas or MG1 Fault
phContext: Toyota Corolla Cross/Yaris Cross HEV, BYD DM-i; empty tank
symptoms: Engine cranks via MG1 for 5 sec then stops, P0A0F + P3190
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify fuel level FIRST (hybrids can drain HV pack trying to crank an empty fuel tank!). 2. Check throttle body cleanliness and MAF. 3. Check 12V fuel pump operation.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Lost Comm with Battery Energy Control Module (BECM)
phContext: HEV/PHEV/EV; blown BECM 12V fuse or flooded pack connector
symptoms: No READY mode, no HV battery SOC displayed
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 12V IG/B+ fuse for BMS/BECM. 2. Inspect low-voltage communication plug on HV battery pack for floodwater. 3. Check CAN-H/L resistance.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Hybrid Battery Positive Contactor Stuck Closed — Welded Relay
phContext: High-mileage HEVs jumped repeatedly with weak 12V or high load
symptoms: HV warning on, contactor fails weld-check at key-off
diagnosticSteps: 1. Monitor SMR1/SMR2/SMR3 contactor voltage PIDs at key-off. 2. With HV gloves & service plug out, check contactor continuity. 3. Replace System Main Relay (SMR) assembly.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Precharge Contactor Circuit Stuck / Slow Precharge
phContext: EVs/HEVs; blown precharge resistor or shorted inverter capacitor
symptoms: Car refuses READY, clicks once then aborts
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check inverter capacitor voltage ramp at READY command (must reach HV pack voltage within ~1 sec). 2. Measure precharge resistor (typically 20–50 ohms). 3. Replace faulty precharge relay/resistor.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: BYD / EV Low-Speed Pedestrian Sounder (AVAS) Silent/Fault
phContext: BYD Atto 3/Dolphin/Sealion 6; bumper speaker flooded
symptoms: AVAS warning on screen, silent below 30 km/h
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect front bumper AVAS speaker connector for mud/water. 2. Test speaker impedance (4–8 ohms). 3. Replace waterlogged AVAS module.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Regenerative Braking Weak or Disabled — Cold/Full Battery or ABS
phContext: HEV/EVs descending Baguio at 100% SOC, or wheel speed fault
symptoms: Friction brakes heat up, regen bar stays at 0
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check HV Battery SOC (at >95– 100% SOC, regen is disabled to protect cells!). 2. Scan ABS/VSC for wheel speed faults (any ABS fault disables regen). 3. Verify brake pedal stroke sensor.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: HV System Regenerative Malfunction (Toyota) — Secondary ABS Flag
phContext: Toyota HEVs; whenever HV ECU sets a fault, ABS sets C1259
symptoms: ABS + Brake + Hybrid lights all on together
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan HV Control ECU first — C1259 is a secondary notification. 2. Fix primary HV fault. 3. Clear codes in both HV and ABS.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: EV 12V Battery Draining Rapidly When Parked — Telematics / OTA
phContext: Connected EVs (BYD, Tesla, MG) parked in weak-signal basement
symptoms: 12V battery dead after 3–4 days despite HV pack >50%
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if smart-charging 12V maintenance mode is enabled in infotainment. 2. Update BMS/gateway firmware. 3. Replace weak 12V LFP/lead-acid aux battery.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Battery Energy Control Module Internal Fault — BMS Cell Tap
phContext: EVs/PHEVs; damaged internal BMS slave board or ribbon
symptoms: Sudden turtle mode (power limit), cell voltage reads 0V or 5V
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan individual cell voltages (100+ cells) to spot single 0V/outlier cell. 2. Distinguish between dead cell vs. broken BMS sense wire. 3. Repair/replace BMS slave module.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: PHEV Fuel Stale / Engine Maintenance Mode Triggered
phContext: BYD Sealion 6 DM-i / PHEVs driven 95% on EV in city
symptoms: ICE turns on automatically even with full battery
diagnosticSteps: 1. Explain normal OEM fuel/oil maintenance cycle (runs ICE periodically to burn off moisture/lubricate). 2. Check fuel age (>3–6 months E10 degrades!). 3. Verify no active ECM DTCs.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: DC-DC Converter Status Circuit — Open Sense Wire
phContext: Toyota/Honda HEVs; broken 12V feedback wire to inverter
symptoms: Battery light on, 12V charges at fixed 13.5V fallback
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check continuity of DC-DC voltage sense wire from inverter to 12V fuse box. 2. Check 7.5A/10A ALT-S fuse. 3. Clear DTC.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: EV Charger Slows to 1.5 kW — Overheated Wall Plug / Voltage Sag
phContext: PH provinces/subdivisions with 195–205V line sag or loose outlet
symptoms: Charging time doubles, plug feels hot to touch
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure AC outlet voltage under 16A/32A load (severe sag <195V triggers thermal/current derate). 2. Inspect wall plug for loose brass prongs! 3. Lower charger amps or upgrade wiring.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Hybrid/EV Battery System Voltage Too Low — Deep Discharge
phContext: EVs left parked at 0% SOC for weeks
symptoms: Car completely dead, refuses to accept AC charge
diagnosticSteps: 1. Charge/jump 12V aux battery first so BMS wakes up. 2. Connect slow AC charger to trigger wake-up charge (if BMS hasn't permanently locked out). 3. Perform controlled cell-pack recovery.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Nissan e-POWER (Kicks) Engine Revs High at Low Speed — Battery Full/Hot
phContext: Nissan Kicks e-POWER; normal thermal/SOC management vs. fault
symptoms: 1.2L generator engine revs to 4000 RPM while crawling in traffic
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check HV battery temp and SOC PIDs (when full descending or hot, system uses engine braking to dump energy!). 2. Check inverter coolant pump operation. 3. Scan for generator DTCs.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Drive Motor A Position Sensor (Resolver) Circuit — Moisture
phContext: HEV/EV transaxle; loose resolver plug or water ingress
symptoms: Car jerks violently or won't move in D/R
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure resolver excitation, sin+, sin-, cos+, cos- coil resistances at inverter plug (typically 10–30 ohms). 2. Check shield ground. 3. Perform resolver offset calibration after repair.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Brake Calipers Seizing on EV/HEV — Unused Friction Brakes
phContext: EVs using heavy one-pedal regen in city traffic
symptoms: Squeaking/scraping brakes, rusted rotor face
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect brake rotors for heavy surface rust from minimal use. 2. Disassemble and lubricate caliper slide pins every 10,000 km. 3. Perform occasional firm mechanical stops.

domainName: Hybrid, EV (HEV/PHEV/BEV) & High-Voltage Systems (PH Emerging Fleet)
title: Drive Motor A Position Sensor Not Learned — Inverter Swap
phContext: HEV/EVs after transaxle or inverter replacement
symptoms: P0C17 active, power limited
diagnosticSteps: 1. Run Resolver Zero-Point / Offset Calibration routine via OEM diagnostic software. 2. Verify smooth motor phase current on test drive. 3. Clear DTC.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: 24V Dual-Battery One-Side Boiling — Illegal 12V Radio Tap
phContext: Isuzu Elf/Forward, Hino, Fuso; driver tapped 12V stereo/dashcam to 1 battery
symptoms: Battery #1 dead/sulfated, Battery #2 boiling acid; no-crank
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check resting voltage of both 12V batteries in series (must match within 0.1V; combined 25.2V). 2. Remove any wire tapped to center jumper post. 3. Wire 24V-to-12V step-down converter for all 12V accessories.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: J1939 Rail Pressure Low (P0087) — Clogged Sedimenter
phContext: Isuzu 4HK1/4JJ1, Hino N04C, Fuso 4P10; dirty fleet diesel
symptoms: Derate / limp mode on NLEX/SLEX hills, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drain water sedimenter on frame rail and replace primary + secondary fuel filters. 2. Monitor Actual vs. Target Rail Pressure (30–180 MPa). 3. Test SCV and injector return flow.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: DPF Differential Pressure High (P2463) — Urban Delivery Soot
phContext: Euro-4 Modern PUVs & Isuzu/Hino/Fuso city delivery trucks
symptoms: DPD/DPF light flashing, truck locked at 40 km/h limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check DPF Soot Load % and Diff Pressure kPa. 2. Verify exhaust temp sensors (EGT1/EGT2) read accurately. 3. Perform parked manual DPD regeneration (ensure away from flammables!).

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Exhaust Brake Inoperative — Burnt Solenoid or Clutch Switch
phContext: Isuzu Elf, Hino 300, Fuso Canter; downhill mountain hauling
symptoms: Exhaust brake indicator doesn't light, no engine braking on descents
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check clutch pedal switch and accelerator idle switch PIDs (must both be released!). 2. Test 24V exhaust brake magnetic valve & vacuum/air actuator. 3. Check butterfly flap shaft for soot seizure.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: SAE J1939 Data Link Fault — Damaged Frame-Rail Harness
phContext: Commercial trucks; chaffed yellow/green J1939 pair along chassis
symptoms: ABS, Engine, and Instrument Cluster lose sync, gauges drop
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure J1939 CAN-H to CAN-L at 9-pin Deutsch / 16-pin OBD port (60 ohms). 2. Inspect harness clips along chassis rail near battery box/transmission. 3. Repair twisted pair.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: 24V Alternator Overcharging (>29.5V) — Bad Ground / Sense
phContext: Trucks with rusted cab-to-chassis ground strap
symptoms: Headlight bulbs blow weekly, batteries boil dry
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure charging voltage at batteries (spec 27.6–28.8V; >29.5V = overcharge). 2. Test voltage drop between alternator housing and battery negative. 3. Replace 24V IC regulator.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Heavy-Duty EGR Flow Insufficient — Soot-Caked Cooler
phContext: Isuzu 4HK1, Hino N04C; heavy idling at port/warehouse queues
symptoms: Engine overheats slightly, MIL on, sluggish pull
diagnosticSteps: 1. Actuate DC-motor EGR valve via scan tool and watch position feedback. 2. Remove EGR cooler and inspect for carbon blockage or coolant leak. 3. Clean cooler and intake throttle valve.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: 24V Starter Relay Welded — Cranks Continuously
phContext: High-amperage 24V starter systems with cheap aftermarket relay
symptoms: Starter stays engaged after releasing key, smoke from cables
diagnosticSteps: 1. Immediately disconnect battery master switch. 2. Replace welded 24V starter magnetic switch/relay with OEM Denso/Nikko unit. 3. Inspect starter pinion.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Engine Overtemp Condition — Mud-Packed Intercooler/Radiator
phContext: Construction dump trucks & provincial haulers
symptoms: Buzzer sounds on dash, engine derates torque by 50%
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect gap between A/C condenser, charge air cooler, and radiator (often packed solid with cement/mud dust). 2. Check viscous fan clutch engagement. 3. Flush cooling core externally.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: 24V Main ECM Relay Intermittent — Corroded Frame Relay Box
phContext: Isuzu/Fuso/Hino with chassis-mounted fuse/relay box
symptoms: Truck stalls randomly over bumps, restarts after tapping relay box
diagnosticSteps: 1. Open chassis relay box and check for water/rust on 24V Main Relay pins. 2. Test relay coil resistance (typically 180–320 ohms for 24V relays!). 3. Replace corroded relay & seal cover.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: CKP Sensor Circuit — Flywheel Housing Oil/Dust Contamination
phContext: High-mileage commercial diesels with rear main seal seep
symptoms: Sudden stall while hauling, hard restart
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull CKP sensor from bellhousing and clean oily clutch dust off tip. 2. Measure sensor coil resistance and check harness near exhaust pipe. 3. Scope CKP waveform.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Air-Over-Hydraulic / Full Air Brake Pressure Builds Slowly
phContext: Isuzu Forward, Hino 500, Fuso Fighter; worn compressor / wet tank
symptoms: Low Air buzzer stays on >5 minutes, brakes locked
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drain water/oil sludge from all air receiver tanks daily! 2. Soap-test air dryer purge valve, governor lines, and brake chambers for leaks. 3. Check air compressor reed valves.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Commercial ABS Sensor Open — Rear Dual-Wheel Hub Vibration
phContext: Isuzu/Hino trucks; loose wheel bearing nut wobbling tone ring
symptoms: ABS warning light on dash, trailer/truck ABS disabled
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check rear wheel hub bearing preload/play! 2. Push ABS sensor gently inward until it touches tone ring (self-adjusting friction fit on heavy hubs). 3. Test sensor AC output.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Injector High-Voltage / EDU Boost Fault (Isuzu 4HK1/6HK1)
phContext: Isuzu Forward/Giga; EDU mounted on engine block vibrating
symptoms: Cylinders 1–4 or 2–3 misfire together, heavy knock
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 24V supply and ground to EDU/IDM. 2. Inspect injector harness pass-through connector at valve cover for oil wicking. 3. Test injector coil insulation.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Fuel Priming Pump Air Leak — Truck Loses Prime Overnight
phContext: Manual priming pump diaphragm cracked on filter head
symptoms: Starts and dies after 10 seconds every morning, needs hand-priming
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace worn hand primer pump assembly on fuel filter housing. 2. Inspect clear return/supply lines for air bubbles while running. 3. Tighten banjo copper washers.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: ECT Sensor High Input — Broken Wire on Cab-Tilt Harness
phContext: Cab-over trucks (Elf, Canter, Hino); wires flexed every cab tilt
symptoms: Temp gauge drops to 0, cooling fan/derate triggered
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect main harness hinge loop at front cab tilt pivot! 2. Repair work-hardened broken wires with extra slack. 3. Check 5V bias at ECT plug.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: 24V System Voltage Low (<22V) — Loose Battery Master Switch
phContext: Trucks equipped with rotary battery cut-off switch
symptoms: Random ECM resets, dim lights, hard starting
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure voltage drop across rotary battery master switch during crank (must be <0.3V). 2. Clean oxidized switch contacts or replace with heavy-duty 300A+ switch. 3. Check alternator belt.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: VGT Turbo Actuator Fault (Hino / Fuso / Isuzu) — Soot Jam
phContext: Euro-4+ commercial trucks; electronic VGT motor overheating
symptoms: Limp mode, MIL on, no turbo whistle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect VGT actuator arm and check vane smoothness. 2. Check 24V power, ground, and CAN-bus to smart VGT actuator. 3. Clean turbo nozzle ring.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Clutch Booster / Servo Air Leak — Heavy Clutch Pedal
phContext: Medium-duty trucks (Forward, Hino 500) with air-assisted clutch
symptoms: Clutch pedal suddenly requires huge leg force, air hissing under cab
diagnosticSteps: 1. Listen under cab near clutch slave booster when pressing pedal. 2. Check air supply line to clutch servo. 3. Rebuild clutch booster seals.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: DPF / DOC Catalyst Efficiency Low — Sulfur Poisoning
phContext: Euro-4 trucks running high-sulfur off-brand fuel
symptoms: Repeated DPF codes even after manual regen
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check fuel sulfur/quality used by fleet. 2. Inspect DOC front face for melting or ash glazing. 3. Remove DPF for professional ash-cleaning.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Speed Limiter / RPM Governor Fault — Tampered VSS Signal
phContext: Modern PUVs & expressway trucks with mandatory 60/80 km/h limiter
symptoms: Truck stuck at 30 km/h or speedo dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect transmission tailhousing VSS connector for tampering or water. 2. Verify speedometer gear/Hall sensor pulse. 3. Check ECM speed limiter parameter.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Turbo Overboost on Heavy Uphill Haul — Wastegate Stuck
phContext: Mechanical/VGT trucks hauling overloaded cargo
symptoms: Sudden power cut (fuel cut protection) climbing steep grades
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check boost pressure sensor PID and wastegate actuator diaphragm/hose. 2. Apply hand pressure to wastegate actuator (must open smoothly around 100–130 kPa). 3. Free stuck wastegate flap.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: 24V Power Window / Wiper Slow — Voltage Drop at Cab Hinge
phContext: Older commercial trucks; corroded A-pillar & cab-tilt plugs
symptoms: Wipers crawl slowly in heavy rain, windows jam
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure voltage at wiper motor under load (expect >24V running). 2. Clean main cab-front bulkhead connectors. 3. Lubricate wiper linkage pivots.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Rail Pressure Sensor High — Broken Ground in Valve Cover
phContext: Isuzu 4HK1, Hino J08E; brittle hot wires under engine cover
symptoms: Cranks no start or severe knock
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check FRP sensor 5V, GND, and signal at ECM plug vs. sensor plug. 2. Inspect valve cover sub-harness for oil-soaked brittle insulation. 3. Replace sub-harness.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Alternator Belt Snapping Frequently — Misaligned Pulleys
phContext: Trucks with worn water pump/idler bearing or aftermarket alternator bracket
symptoms: Belt shreds every few weeks, battery drains
diagnosticSteps: 1. Use straightedge across crank, water pump, and alternator pulleys to check alignment. 2. Spin all idler/tensioner bearings for wobble. 3. Replace worn tensioner.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Control Module Performance — 24V Welding Without Disconnect
phContext: Trucks after chassis/body welding without disconnecting batteries/ECM
symptoms: ECM dead or erratic sensor outputs after body repair
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always disconnect BOTH battery terminals and ECM plugs before arc welding! 2. Test 5V VREF regulators inside ECM. 3. Replace damaged ECM.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Center Bearing / U-Joint Vibration Under Load
phContext: Long-wheelbase trucks & jeepneys; dry greaseable U-joints
symptoms: Violent floor vibration at 40–60 km/h under acceleration
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect driveshaft U-joints for red rust dust (dry needle bearings) and center carrier bearing rubber tear. 2. Check driveshaft phasing. 3. Replace U-joints and grease regularly.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Low Oil Pressure Buzzer — Faulty Sender vs. Worn Oil Pump
phContext: All commercial trucks; oil pressure switch weeping oil
symptoms: Red oil lamp + loud cab buzzer at hot idle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Immediately shut down and attach mechanical oil pressure gauge! 2. If mechanical pressure is good (>100 kPa idle), replace faulty 1-pin oil sender. 3. If low, inspect bearings/relief valve.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Headlight / Clearance Marker Lights Blowing Fuses — Body Rub
phContext: Aluminum van/wingvan trucks; rear marker wires pinched by cargo/frame
symptoms: All clearance/tail lights dead, 15A/20A fuse blows on switch-on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug rear body harness at chassis tail connector to isolate cab vs. cargo box short. 2. Inspect clearance lamp wires along aluminum framing for rub-through. 3. Protect with loom.

domainName: 24V Commercial Trucks, Jeepneys & Heavy-Duty Diesel (Isuzu / Hino / Fuso)
title: Fuel Rail Pressure Too High — Stuck Pressure Limiter / SCV
phContext: Isuzu 4JJ1/4HK1, Hino; return line kinked or SCV jammed open
symptoms: Loud diesel knock, safety relief valve pops open, limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check fuel return line to tank for kinks/crushed pipe from road debris! 2. Inspect SCV operation and rail pressure relief valve. 3. Replace SCV and reset pump learn.
